subject: Draw this scene: a planted bed of common reeds at the water's edge. Tall thin green reed stems with long narrow leaves standing thick in shallow blue water, topped with feathery tan-gold plume heads, and along the front of the bed a short low row of driven wooden stakes with a woven edging, showing it was planted by hand; open water and a far shore of dark trees behind, a pale sky.
